pending_commit.commit_message: u2fd: Always enable user keys This change deprecates the "legacy" code path, and enables legacy fallback if users have not swiched explicitly to the new code path. This is a forced migration to the new code path, while still supporting legacy key handles for authentication. For a user who has previously enabled U2F with 'u2f' or 'g2f' mode (but not switched to user keys), this change will cause new registrations to be user-specific, but old keys can still be used to authenticate. No user action is required for this behavior. u2fd: Ignore unsupported vendor mode command Existing builds of cr50 support the vendor mode commands, but future builds will not. Ignore such errors if we encounter them. init: Add a directory for persistent namespace references. The end state of namespace usage for Chrome and cryptohome has user data mounts very closely tracking process lifetime. However, while we figure out the exact details of said lifetimes, create a directory where we can keep persistent references to namespaces. This way namespace lifetime can be ultimately controlled by unmounting bind mounts in this directory. The directory is bind-mounted to itself to be able to mark it as private and prevent the namespace references from flowing into non-root namespaces.
